scope: canonical delivery lane classification for repository-writer governance tests
symptom: Required preflight failed closed in Classify independent delivery lanes because three repository-writer governance test paths were present in the candidate but absent from the delivery lane classifier.
root_cause: The repository-writer contract tests were added or retained as governance verification, but config/brain-delivery-system.json had not yet declared their canonical owner lane. Change-Scope metadata was already correct; the missing authority was the delivery classifier itself.
fix: Add only the three known repository-writer governance test paths to the automation delivery lane; preserve fail-closed behavior for unrelated future tests.
prevention: CLASSIFIER_COCHANGE_REQUIRED: every new material governance or contract test must receive canonical lane classification in the same change that introduces or activates it.
FAIL_CLOSED_UNCLASSIFIED_PATHS: an unknown delivery path remains an error; never add a broad tests/** escape solely to make CI green.
BOUNDED_CLASSIFICATION: prefer exact paths or an already-established bounded family over catch-all patterns.
CHANGE_SCOPE_IS_NOT_LANE_AUTHORITY: a path being declared in PR Change-Scope does not replace delivery-lane classification; both contracts must be satisfied independently.
EXACT_HEAD_ONLY: classifier recovery evidence is valid only on the exact current PR head; superseded runs remain historical diagnosis evidence.

evidence.classifier_readback: config/brain-delivery-system.json assigns the three named paths to automation while the regression test requires an unrelated future writer test to remain unclassified.

terminal_acceptance: Update status only after Required and BRAIN delivery are terminal green on one exact head, protected merge succeeds with expected-head identity, current main contains the candidate ancestry, and main/runtime readback is green.
